# Soul Buns & Balls

> Independent smash burger bar in Kalamata, Greece. Short menu, fresh daily, open Tuesday to Sunday from 18:00 until sold out. No reservations: first come, first served.

- Address: Anagnostara 3, Kalamata 24100, Greece
- Phone: +30 2721 303682
- Email: soulbunsandballs@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Sunday from 18:00 until sold out; closed Monday
- Service: dine in at the bar, takeaway, delivery via Wolt (https://wolt.com/el/grc/kalamata/restaurant/soul-buns-balls)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soulbunsandballs/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/soulbunsandballs/

## Menu (EUR)
Burgers: Single Smash 6.5, Double Smash 9, Triple Smash 11.5 (smashed beef patty, cheddar, homemade pickles, iceberg, onions, soul secret sauce); Oldschool 9 (classic beef patty, same toppings); Burger of the Month (changes monthly, seasonal ingredients).
Fries & sauces: Side fries 2, Whole fries 4, Loaded fries 9 (fries, sauce, smashed patty, cheddar). Sauces: Soul 1.5, Garlic 1.5, Sriracha 1.5, Truffle 2, Ketchup 1, Mayo 1.
Drinks: Cola 2, Zero 2, Sprite 2, Schweppes 2.5, Sparkling water 1.5, Water 0.5; Carlsberg 4, Kalamata 5, Sura 5, IPA beer 6; Paloma 7.

## Burger of the Month — November 2026
Kuchisabishii Smash: potato bun, smashed patties, cheddar, pickled mushrooms, cabbage, crunchy fried onion, Kewpie mayo, tonkatsu ponzu ketchup.

## Στα ελληνικά
Το Soul Buns & Balls είναι ανεξάρτητο smash burger bar στην Καλαμάτα (Αναγνωσταρά 3, 24100). Ανοιχτά Τρίτη–Κυριακή από τις 18:00 μέχρι να τελειώσουν τα burgers· Δευτέρα κλειστά. Χωρίς κρατήσεις. Φαγητό στο μπαρ, πακέτο ή delivery μέσω Wolt. Μενού: Single/Double/Triple Smash (6.5/9/11.5€), Oldschool (9€), Burger του μήνα, πατάτες (2/4€), loaded fries (9€), σάλτσες, αναψυκτικά, μπίρες, Paloma. Τηλέφωνο +30 2721 303682.
